slices.title: Start an API run (Ask, no tools)
slices.summary: POST /v1/agent/runs: body parsed against the S3 allow-list, a key-owned thread opened or continued via session_flow::prepare_run_with_bearer with the key session bearer, one Ask turn run in a detached task with no tools offered and the key's aud=inference-core bearer, completed through the managed terminal path; returns 202 {data:{run_id, thread_id, status}}. Accepts one x-inference-authorization api_key bearer on that route only. Per-key cap of 2 live runs per replica.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p model-gateway --lib agent_api_run
cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p model-gateway --lib agent_api_routes
